# Product Roadmap

Status: Accepted

Target Milestone: Personal reading list MVP

## Increment 1 - Capture books

Status: Accepted

- Add a book with a required title.
- View all captured books in insertion order.

Acceptance Criteria: 1 and 2.

## Increment 2 - Reading progress

Status: Planned

- Mark a book as read or unread.
- Filter books by all, unread, or read status.

Acceptance Criteria: 3 and 4.
